extraction_scope: Worker-6 adjudicated mechanism claims from source-located microscopy, Results, and Discussion sections without promoting literature-only membrane context to direct mechanism evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Fengycin treatment produced prominent vesicle-like swollen structures in Venturia inaequalis hyphae; surfactin produced similar changes less systematically, while mycosubtilin did not produce vesicles.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: fengycin, surfactin, mycosubtilin treatments of S755 and rs552 Venturia inaequalis strains

source_locator.note: Optical microscopy section and Figure 4 describe treatment-associated morphology.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Morphology was observed directly, but the authors caution that vesicle-like structures were not simply correlated with antifungal IC50 activity.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper interprets lipopeptide mode of action through membrane interaction and ergosterol-related context, but this is literature-supported discussion rather than a direct biochemical assay in this paper.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Bacillus subtilis cyclic lipopeptides tested against Venturia inaequalis

source_locator.note: Discussion links differential strain responses to membrane properties and ergosterol context using cited literature.

mechanism_claims.limitations: No membrane permeabilization, ergosterol quantification, or target-enzyme assay was performed in the recovered local material.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Fengycin plus surfactin and ternary FSM mixtures showed strong activity on the reduced-sensitivity strain, supporting a source-reviewed synergy hypothesis but not a quantified FICI calculation.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: FS and FSM mixtures against Venturia inaequalis rs552

source_locator.note: Results text and Table 3 support FS/FSM activity patterns; the source frames synergy as possible.

mechanism_claims.limitations: No FICI or checkerboard synergy endpoint was reported in the local primary material.
